diagnosis: Check C5, which is supposed to depend on PF3 (family transportation confirmation), passed in every single rollout despite the decision-maker never having access to PF3. In all rollouts, the model defaulted to a 4:00 p.m. departure time and Tuesday/Thursday attendance based solely on public facts or generic assumptions, making the hidden information in PF3 irrelevant to the outcome.

C5.why: The family transportation confirmation changes the attendance days from Tuesday and Thursday to Monday and Wednesday and sets the required departure time at 4:00 p.m.
